chapters.title: Finding the Furry Cat!
topics: position words: above, below, inside, outside, on, under, near, far
covers: Sings a rhyme about searching for a cat and points to where things are
Says where an object sits relative to another, such as the ball above the bed
Circles the correct position word in a sentence about a picture
Gives and follows spoken directions in a hide-and-find game in the classroom
Decides whether everyday things like shoes or rubbish go inside or outside

chapters.title: What is Long?
covers: Names things around the room that are long and things that are round
Sorts drawn objects into round and long groups
Matches objects that have the same shape
Ticks the shape that looks like a ball
Argues for a choice, since one object can look long from one side and round from another

chapters.title: Mango Treat
topics: counting one more at a time
covers: Counts animals and birds as each one joins a tree-side story, saying the new total
Reads and writes the number that is one more than each number up to 9
Matches a number of birds to the same number of fingers
Acts out the story with classmates and makes the animal sounds
Talks about the birds and animals in the picture and where they live

chapters.title: Making 10
topics: dot patterns to see numbers without counting
numbers 10 to 20 as ten and ones
covers: Writes how many dots a ladybug has and makes dot designs with seeds, bindis or buttons
Plays a dice game, colouring boxes to match the number rolled
Follows a story of buttons falling off and finds that nothing left means zero
Finds number pairs that make 10, such as 9 and 1, using fingers and a pattern table
Counts out beads or buttons to make a string or frame of ten

chapters.title: How Many?
topics: words like altogether, total and make
covers: Joins two groups of objects and counts the total
Writes addition sentences for pictures of children, tops, ants and pencils
Adds numbers by drawing and counting, for example 6 balls and 2 balls
Rolls two dice and adds the dots on them, then compares scores with a friend
Counts the fingers on two hands and the family members in their own family

chapters.title: Vegetable Farm
topics: counting on from the bigger number
adding in more than one way
covers: Adds two baskets of vegetables, such as 7 tomatoes and 5 tomatoes
Counts on from 12 by 4 more, using beads on a ginladi (a bead frame) to see the answer
Works out a sum such as 12 + 6 in more than one way, for example by making ten first
Solves short word problems about pencils, laddoos and bangles
Plants a sapling at home or school and keeps a record of how it grows

chapters.title: Lina's Family
topics: comparing heights: taller, shorter, tallest, shortest
covers: Counts the members of a family and finds the tallest and shortest
Finds who is taller than one person but shorter than another
Compares heights of people in their own class
Says which place is nearer or farther from a house, shop or school on a map picture
Learns about a famous tall statue in Gujarat

chapters.title: Fun with Numbers
topics: tens and ones with tens frames
covers: Reads and writes the number words from twenty one to fifty
Fills tens frames to show a number and counts on a ginladi
Fills in missing numbers on a 1 to 100 grid and in a snake-and-ladder style game
Counts forward and backward from any number, including past 50
Talks about a Warli painting, counting the houses and people in the picture

chapters.title: Utsav
covers: Finds the repeating pattern in a festival scene
Extends a row of shapes by drawing the next pieces
Makes patterns with real objects such as beads or buttons
Talks about local festivals like Pongal, Bihu and Lohri and what they celebrate

chapters.title: How do I Spend my Day?
topics: parts of the day: morning, afternoon, evening, night
covers: Follows a child's day from waking up to going to sleep, in pictures and words
Says the order of their own daily routine
Ticks activities that happen in the morning, during the day and at night
Names when they brush their teeth and take a bath
Links sun and moon pictures to the time of day

chapters.title: How Many Times?
covers: Counts equal groups at an amusement park, such as 2 + 2 + 2 + 2
Writes the total for groups of 3 in trains and 5 in a big wheel
Finds the total pieces of jalebi on several plates, each with 3 pieces
Says a multiplication as repeated groups, for example 6 times 3
Counts seats and bottles on a bus using groups

chapters.title: How Much Can We Spend?
topics: finding how much more is needed
covers: Names the coins and notes in use and says their values
Pays the same amount in different ways, for example 20 rupees with 5-rupee coins or with 10-rupee notes
Picks toys to buy with 10 or 20 rupees
Works out how much more money is needed to buy a toy that costs more than the money held
Plays a classroom shop game with paper play money

chapters.title: So Many Toys
topics: more than, less than, equal to
covers: Counts each kind of toy in a picture
Uses more than, less than and equal to to compare the counts
Finds the colour of flowers that are most and least common
Decides true or false for statements about counts
Surveys classmates by the number of letters in their names
